## Loading packages

```{r packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import dataset

```{r Reading Dataset, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
All_Country <- read_csv("Data/Processed/AllCountries_Processed.csv")
```

## Analysis

Linear regression model between "Electricity Bill Price" and "Outage Duration Hours" to see if the higher the electricity bill, the more stable the connection is.

```{r ggplot by country}
#Kenya
All_Country %>% 
  filter(Country == "Kenya") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OutageDurationHours, y = ElectricityBillPriceUSD)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

#Liberia
All_Country %>% 
  filter(Country == "Liberia") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OutageDurationHours, y = ElectricityBillPriceUSD)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

#Niger
All_Country %>% 
  filter(Country == "Niger") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OutageDurationHours, y = ElectricityBillPriceUSD)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

#Rwanda
All_Country %>% 
  filter(Country == "Rwanda") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OutageDurationHours, y = ElectricityBillPriceUSD)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")

#Zambia
All_Country %>% 
  filter(Country == "Zambia") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OutageDurationHours, y = ElectricityBillPriceUSD)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

Liberia is currently missing the values on Electricity bill price. Niger has some very large values on outage duration hours. Zambia somehow has some negative values on outage duration hours.

```{r ggplot all country}
All_Country %>% 
  filter(OutageDurationHours >= 0 & OutageDurationHours <= 168) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = OutageDurationHours, y = ElectricityBillPriceUSD)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_classic()
```

I removed the values larger than 168 hours in the outage duration hours column, because a week can only have 168 hours and any number larger than that is likely an error.

```{r Liner Regression Summary}
All_Country_Filtered <- All_Country %>%
  filter(OutageDurationHours >= 0 & OutageDurationHours <= 168)

LinearRegression <- lm(ElectricityBillPriceUSD ~ OutageDurationHours,
                       data = All_Country_Filtered)

summary(LinearRegression)
```
From the Linear Regression summary the R value is 0.01862, showing a very week positive correlation between Electricity Bill Price and Outage Duration Hours.
